description: This file contains unit tests for Java serialization of OpenMRS domain objects, specifically testing serialization and deserialization of Person and Concept objects using Apache Commons SerializationUtils.

classes.name: JavaSerializationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the serialization and deserialization of OpenMRS domain objects such as Person and Concept using Apache Commons SerializationUtils.

methods.name: shouldSerializeOpenMrsData
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of Person object, asserting that the deserialized object retains all original field values.

methods.name: shouldSerializeOpenMrsMetadata
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of Concept object, asserting that the deserialized object retains all original field values.
